title: Dwayne Johnson Leads Crowd in ‘Happy Birthday’ Song for Daughter Simone After Receiving Disney Legend Award at D23
content:
Johnson's "Jungle Cruise" and "Smashing Machine" co-star Emily Blunt presented the award

Dwayne Johnson has been officially crowned a legend — aDisney Legendthat is.

On Sunday atD23, Johnson was honored with the hall-of-fame-style award from the Walt Disney Company. From “Jungle Cruise” to the “Moana” franchise and “Race to Witch Mountain,” Johnson is no stranger to the world of Disney. But as he took the stage to receive the honor, Johnson emphasized that his most important role is that of father.

During his off-the-cuff speech, Johnson recalled the first time he took his eldest daughter Simone to Disneyland. She was five years old, and they had breakfast with the princesses.

“I was in my 20s … I was trying to figure that stuff out at that time: how I was going to be a father, how I was going to be a husband, man, etc,” he recalled. “But I remember one of the princesses said, ‘Close your eyes and make a wish.’ And I’ll never forget, [Simone] closed her eyes and she made a wish.”

Johnson continued, getting a little emotional at the memory: “I just remember that moment on my daughter’s face. I had never seen that before. She was just so into making a wish. … I said, ‘God, I wonder what was going through the little mind.’ And it’s just experiences like that that we create that I know she’ll never forget. I’ll never forget. That’s the beauty of Disney. That’s the beauty also of being a Disney Legend.”

As it turns out, the Disney Legends ceremony took place just after Simone’s 25th birthday, so he led the full arena in a “Happy Birthday” tribute to her.

Dwayne Johnson has the#D23crowd sing “Happy Birthday” to his daughter after receiving his Disney Legends Award.pic.twitter.com/BLpAHHtYh0

During his emotional remarks, Johnson also shouted out his younger daughters, Jasmine and Tiana, who were watching at home. “They asked me, ‘What does it mean to be a Disney Legend?'” he recalled. “I said, ‘Well, it means we get free tickets.'”

Johnson was presented with his Disney Legends award by his “Jungle Cruise” and “The Smashing Machine” co-star Emily Blunt, who made a surprise appearance at the award to wax poetic about her friend.

“When I first met Dwayne Johnson, I had assumed wrongly that he would have the energy of a man who was a sort of walking suplex,” Blunt said. “But the bravado of ‘The Rock’ was actually nowhere to be seen.” Johnson’s persona as “The Rock” is just a performance, she explained. “It’s the performance of a lifetime

“What I was met with was someone who was so disarmingly wise, gentle, curious, totally unpretentious,” Blunt continued. “And not to say this one’s an angel, all right, because he’s not. He’s a non-conforming, rule-breaking, mold-breaking rebel.”

Emily Blunt calls Dwayne Johnson “disarmingly wise, gentle, curious and totally unpretentious” while honoring him as a Disney Legend at#D23:“And that’s not to say this one’s an angel, all right, because he’s not. He’s a non-conforming, rule-breaking, mold-breaking rebel.”pic.twitter.com/fBwRhIyFq6

This summer, Johnson brought “Moana” back to the big screen for a live-action voyage and reprised his role as the demi-god Maui. In the lead-up to the movie’s debut, Johnson spoke about bringing Pacific Islander culture to the masses, and why the “Moana” cinematic universe matters for representation and visibility. Johnson, who also produced the movie, said he didn’t see himself represented in media when he was growing up: “‘Indiana Jones’ inspired me. When I was 8 years old watching Harrison Ford, I was like, ‘I want to be that guy,’ but that guy didn’t look like me.”

As mentioned, the “Moana” movies are just part of Johnson’s legacy with the company. In 2024,Seven Bucks Productions, the film and TV content label founded byJohnsonand Dany Garcia, signed a first-look deal with The Walt Disney Company to develop films for theatrical and streaming. Last year, 20th Television closed a first-look TV deal with the company.

The Disney Legends Awards program is a 39-year tradition of The Walt Disney Company, which began when Fred MacMurray (“The Shaggy Dog,” “The Absent-Minded Professor,” “The Happiest Millionaire”) was honored in 1987. Including this year’s honorees, a total of 329 Disney Legends have been named.

The 2026 Disney Legends honorees include formerDisney chairman and CEO Bob Iger,Anne Hathaway,Susan Egan and Alan Tudyk, for bringing “unforgettable characters to life on-screen and on-stage.” The Jonas brothers are being honored for “shaping a generation of Disney music,” Lin‑Manuel Miranda for “groundbreaking songwriting for modern Disney favorites” and Eric Goldberg for his “artistry and animation.”

Past Disney Legends include Tim Allen, Dame Julie Andrews, Angela Bassett, Tony Baxter, Kristen Bell, James Cameron, Jamie Lee Curtis, Miley Cyrus, Marc Davis, Robert Downey Jr., Harrison Ford, Annette Funicello, Josh Gad, Whoopi Goldberg, Jonathan Groff, Steve Jobs, Sir Elton John, Dame Angela Lansbury, Stan Lee, George Lucas, Steve Martin, Burny Mattinson, Alan Menken, Idina Menzel, Hayley Mills, Fess Parker, Ellen Pompeo, Robin Roberts, the Sherman Brothers, Marty Sklar, Dick Van Dyke, Barbara Walters, Betty White, John Williams, Robin Williams and Oprah Winfrey.
title_zh: 德維恩·約翰遜(Dwayne Johnson)在D23大會上獲得迪士尼傳奇獎後，帶領觀眾為女兒西蒙(Simone)唱《生日快樂》歌曲。
content_zh:
德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)的《叢林巡遊》(Jungle Cruise)和《摔角機器人》(The Smashing Machine)的共同演員艾蜜莉·布朗特(Emily Blunt)頒發了這個獎項。

德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)正式被冠上傳奇的稱號——迪士尼傳奇(Disney Legend)。

在星期天的D23活動上，強森獲得了華特迪士尼公司(Walt Disney Company)頒發的名人堂獎。從《叢林巡遊》(Jungle Cruise)到《海洋奇緣》(Moana)系列以及《魔境夢遊》(Race to Witch Mountain)，強森對迪士尼的世界並不陌生。但在他走上舞台接受榮譽時，強森強調他最重要的角色是父親。

在即興演講中，強森回憶起第一次帶著他的大女兒西蒙(Simone)去迪士尼樂園的情景。當時她五歲，他們和公主演吃早餐。

“我那時候二十多歲……我在努力弄清楚該怎麼做：我該怎麼當父親，怎麼當丈夫，等等，”他回憶道。“但我記得其中一位公主演說，‘閉上眼睛，許個願望。’我永遠不會忘記，[西蒙]閉上了眼睛，許下了願望。”

強森繼續講述，回憶讓他有些感動：“我只記得我女兒臉上的那一刻。我從未見過那樣的表情。她對許願的那份投入讓我印象深刻……我說，‘天啊，我想知道那小小的腦袋裡在想什麼。’正是這樣的經歷讓我知道她永遠不會忘記。我也永遠不會忘記。這就是迪士尼的美好。這也是成為迪士尼傳奇的美好。”

事實上，迪士尼傳奇的頒獎典禮正好在西蒙25歲生日之後舉行，因此他帶領全場觀眾為她唱起“生日快樂”。

德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)在獲得迪士尼傳奇獎後，帶著#D23的觀眾為他的女兒唱“生日快樂”。 pic.twitter.com/BLpAHHtYh0

在他情感真摯的發言中，強森還提到了他的小女兒們，茉莉(Jasmine)和蒂安娜(Tiana)，她們在家中觀看頒獎典禮。“她們問我，‘成為迪士尼傳奇意味著什麼？’”他回憶道。“我說，‘嗯，這意味著我們可以免費拿票。’”

強森的迪士尼傳奇獎是由他的《叢林巡遊》(Jungle Cruise)和《摔角機器人》(The Smashing Machine)的共同演員艾蜜莉·布朗特(Emily Blunt)頒發的，她在頒獎典禮上驚喜現身，對她的朋友讚不絕口。

“當我第一次見到德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)時，我錯誤地以為他會有一種像是行走的摔角手的能量，”布朗特說。“但‘岩石’(The Rock)的自信其實並不存在。”她解釋說，強森的“岩石”形象只是一種表演。“這是終生難忘的表演。”

“我遇到的是一個如此令人驚訝的智慧、溫柔、好奇，完全不做作的人，”布朗特繼續說。“並不是說他是天使，因為他不是。他是一個不循規蹈矩、打破規則、打破常規的叛逆者。”

艾蜜莉·布朗特(Emily Blunt)在#D23頒獎典禮上榮耀德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)為迪士尼傳奇，稱讚他“令人驚訝的智慧、溫柔、好奇且完全不做作”。她表示：“這並不是說他是一位天使，因為他不是。他是一位不遵循常規、打破規則、突破框架的叛逆者。”

在今年夏天，強森將《海洋奇緣》(Moana)帶回大銀幕，進行了一次真人版的冒險，並重返他所飾演的半神毛伊(Maui)角色。在電影首映之前，強森談到了將太平洋島嶼文化帶給大眾的重要性，以及為何《海洋奇緣》的電影宇宙對於代表性和可見性至關重要。強森表示，當他成長過程中並未在媒體中看到自己的代表：“《印地安那瓊斯》(Indiana Jones)啟發了我。當我8歲時看哈里森·福特(Harrison Ford)的表演，我心想，‘我想成為那個人，’但那個人看起來並不像我。”

如前所述，《海洋奇緣》系列電影只是強森與公司的遺產的一部分。在2024年，強森和丹尼·加西亞(Dany Garcia)創立的七塊錢製作公司(Seven Bucks Productions)與華特迪士尼公司(The Walt Disney Company)簽署了首映合約，以開發電影供院線和串流平台使用。去年，20世紀電視(20th Television)與該公司達成了首映電視合約。

迪士尼傳奇獎項計畫是華特迪士尼公司的一項39年傳統，始於1987年，當時弗雷德·麥克穆瑞(Fred MacMurray)因《毛茸茸的狗》(The Shaggy Dog)、《健忘教授》(The Absent-Minded Professor)和《快樂的百萬富翁》(The Happiest Millionaire)而獲得榮譽。今年的獲獎者使得總共329位迪士尼傳奇誕生。

2026年的迪士尼傳奇獲獎者包括前迪士尼董事長兼首席執行官鮑勃·艾格(Bob Iger)、安妮·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)、蘇珊·伊根(Susan Egan)和艾倫·圖迪克(Alan Tudyk)，因為他們“在銀幕和舞台上帶來了難以忘懷的角色。”喬納斯兄弟(Jonas brothers)因“塑造了一代迪士尼音樂”而獲獎，林-曼努爾·米蘭達(Lin-Manuel Miranda)因“為現代迪士尼經典創作開創性歌曲”而獲獎，艾瑞克·高德堡(Eric Goldberg)則因其“藝術性和動畫”而獲獎。

過去的迪士尼傳奇包括蒂姆·艾倫(Tim Allen)、朱莉·安德魯斯(Dame Julie Andrews)、安吉拉·貝賽特(Angela Bassett)、托尼·巴克斯特(Tony Baxter)、克里斯汀·貝爾(Kristen Bell)、詹姆斯·卡梅隆(James Cameron)、珍妮·李·柯蒂斯(Jamie Lee Curtis)、麥莉·希拉斯(Miley Cyrus)、馬克·戴維斯(Marc Davis)、小羅伯特·唐尼(Robert Downey Jr.)、哈里森·福特(Harrison Ford)、安妮特·富尼洛(Annette Funicello)、喬什·蓋德(Josh Gad)、烏比·戈德堡(Whoopi Goldberg)、喬納森·格羅夫(Jonathan Groff)、史蒂夫·喬布斯(Steve Jobs)、艾爾頓·約翰(Sir Elton John)、安吉拉·蘭斯伯里(Dame Angela Lansbury)、史丹·李(Stan Lee)、喬治·盧卡斯(George Lucas)、史蒂夫·馬丁(Steve Martin)、伯尼·馬丁森(Burny Mattinson)、艾倫·梅肯(Alan Menken)、艾迪娜·門札(Idina Menzel)、海莉·米爾斯(Hayley Mills)、費斯·帕克(Fess Parker)、艾倫·龐佩奧(Ellen Pompeo)、羅賓·羅伯茲(Robin Roberts)、謝爾曼兄弟(Sherman Brothers)、馬提·斯克拉(Marty Sklar)、迪克·范戴克(Dick Van Dyke)、芭芭拉·沃爾特斯(Barbara Walters)、貝蒂·懷特(Betty White)、約翰·威廉斯(John Williams)、羅賓·威廉斯(Robin Williams)和歐普拉·溫弗瑞(Oprah Winfrey)。

德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)的《叢林巡遊》(Jungle Cruise)和《摔角機器人》(The Smashing Machine)的共同演員艾蜜莉·布朗特(Emily Blunt)頒發了這個獎項。

德維恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)正式被冠上傳奇的稱號——迪士尼傳奇(Disney Legend)。
